title: Cartwise+ Membership Long-Standing Member Provision on the Unused Share of a Term
content:
**Provision.** On the early end of a Cartwise+ Membership annual term, the unused share of the term for a long-standing member is measured as follows:

(a) A member whose enrollment date is at least 18 months back and who received no member fee waiver on any order in the last month has the month in progress refunded as well: the unused share is 12 less the whole months of the term already completed, divided by 12.

(b) A member whose enrollment date is at least 18 months back and who received at least one member fee waiver on an order in the last month has the unused share counted in calendar days: the days from today up to the day before the term ends, divided by the days in the term.

(c) For any other member, neither (a) nor (b) applies.

## Records read

- The enrollment date on the membership record, counted in whole months up to today.
- The fee-waiver entries on the member's Cartwise Grocery Orders dated in the last month. The last month is counted as one whole month ending today; a waiver dated on the same day of the month one month back is not counted.
- The term's first day and its end (the renewal date), for the whole months completed and the days of the term.

## Conditions and results

| Enrollment date at least 18 months back | Member fee waiver on an order in the last month | Unused share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 12 less the whole months of the term completed, divided by 12 |
| yes | at least one | days from today up to the day before the term ends, divided by the days in the term |
| no | none | not measured under (a) or (b) |
| no | at least one | not measured under (a) or (b) |

## Boundary of the 18 months (hypothetical)

A member who enrolled on 5 June two years before a 5 December request is 18 months back and meets the enrollment condition; one who enrolled on 6 June of that year is 17 whole months back and does not.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- **Provision (a).** A term that began 10 January, today 25 March: two whole months (10 January to 10 March) are completed, so the unused share is 12 less 2, divided by 12, which is 10 divided by 12.
- **Provision (b).** A term from 10 January of one year to 10 January of the next has 365 days (non-leap year). Today is 25 March; the days from 25 March up to 9 January inclusive are 291, so the unused share is 291 divided by 365.
